how_it_runs: Run previous-release selection on the published release list including prereleases and drafts. Expect the highest eligible production version below the candidate.
Compare the published release body with the intended changelog and migration notes. Reject a body consisting only of the tagged commit message.
Read the release API and releases/latest. Confirm a candidate is prerelease and the latest stable tag still resolves to the preceding production release.
Read the immutable flag and asset digest inventory from the published release. Check every asset against its published digest without mutating the release.
Install verified v4.7.1 as the service user, seed state, back up, migrate to the candidate, strictly parse each -json result, verify serving, restore, and serve again with v4.7.1.
Install verified v4.8.0 as the service user, seed state, back up, migrate to the candidate, strictly parse each -json result, verify serving, restore, and serve again with v4.8.0.

Repeat control-plane backup and restore with known committed audit writes 50 times, then repeat under parallel writers. Export audit rows and verify committed rows are present and the chain verifies in each snapshot.

Run the fine-tuning example with training outcomes enabled. Call the documented training-outcomes endpoint with valid scope and a populated fixture. Require the documented success response with outcomes; record HTTP 503 as a failure.
